name: dsh-plugin-code-reviewer
description: 3 local deterministic tools for DeepSeek Harness: code_review (14 static rules incl. OPC UA/Modbus/MQTT/serial/timeout), mqtt_probe (MQTT packet decoder), opcua_validate (NodeId validator). SCADA/MES/LIMS source scanner. 本地静态代码审查与工业协议解析工具插件。
